displayName: jigak model refresh: alert (model about to expire or refresh failing)

documentation.content: The refresh job logged model-refresh-alert: a model has less than 48 hours left and the refresh failed, or a model already expired. Routing falls back to the provider times meanwhile. Steps: gcloud run jobs executions list --job jigak-model-refresh --region asia-northeast3; read runs/<runId>/report.json in the models bucket; see jigak-backend/docs/MODEL-REFRESH.md.
